tools.name: suggest_registrations
tools.description: Given a name, word, or initials, intelligently suggests number plates that would make for a good match.

tools.name: lookup_registration
tools.description: Given a number plate registration, confirm validity and return the plate format, age identifier, year of issue, region/local office information and notes.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Given a number plate registration, confirm validity and return details of its current availability, pricing, and any additional information about the registration.

tools.name: format_registration
tools.description: Given a number plate registration, correctly space and format it for legal UK road use.

tools.name: bulk_format_registration
tools.description: Given multiple number plate registrations, correctly space and format them for legal UK road use.

tools.name: transfer_requirements
tools.description: Given a number plate registration, explain transfer/retention requirements, likely DVLA steps, vehicle eligibility, and timescales.

tools.name: value_registration
tools.description: Given a number plate registration, estimate its market value based on historical sales and extensive experience, and list comparable registrations offered by National Numbers.
